verdict.rationale: Openness of source is a fair question for a GPU, since buyers can ask about open drivers, firmware or hardware designs. Nothing in the pack shows the RTX PRO 6000's own source (drivers, firmware or design) is readable under an open license. The open-source mentions (NeMo framework, the 5G/6G research library, APIs that mirror open-source tools) are about separate ecosystem software, not this product, so they earn no credit.
